name: matrix-cc
description: Mod matrix over MIDI CC: all 35 matrix amounts sent and received as CCs, -100..+100% as 0..127 with 64 = 0.

region.was: console 'synth' test handler, retired by the 0x080740D4 edit

hooks.was: bl 0x0800EB10 (parameter object constructor, its only call)
ubfx r3,r9,#8,#8 (MIDI in: group of the CC's parameter)
asrs r5,r5,#8; uxtb r1,r5 (MIDI out: CC value in the parameter-change listener)
asrs r7,r7,#8; uxtb r1,r7 (MIDI out: CC value in the set-and-send function)
ldrb r3,[r3,r7]; cmp r3,#0x7f (setter: Local Off refuses CC parameters)
ldrb r3,[r3,r5]; cmp r3,#0x7f (second setter: the same gate)

edits.was: 0x0802CA95, console 'synth' handler -> stock bx lr stub
